data.long_meaning: The name Waverly is derived from the Old English words ‘waefre’ which means ‘wavering’ and ‘leah’ which means ‘wood’ or ‘glade’. The name Waverly is thought to describe a place where the river wavers, or a person who is wavering or uncertain. The name is also associated with the gentle, flowing nature of a river. The name Waverly carries the meaning “Wavering, wavering stream” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Waverly usually hope their child will grow to embody wavering, wavering stream and live with faith, good character and purpose.
